  6. Use generated credentials to login

Teacher:

  4. Go to Applications

## How to Add a New Role

### Step 1: Add to UserRole type
```typescript
// src/hooks/use-current-user.ts
export type UserRole = "admin" | "teacher" | "student" | "finance" | "hostel" | "newrole";
```

### Step 2: Add hardcoded profile (if exclusive role)
```typescript
// src/lib/data.ts
export const userProfiles: Record<UserRole, { name: string; email: string; avatar: string }> = {
  // ... existing roles
  newrole: {
    name: "New Role User",
    email: "newrole@campus.edu",
    avatar: "/avatars/06.png",
  },
};
```

### Step 3: Add navigation menu
```typescript
// src/components/dashboard/sidebar-nav.tsx
const navItems = {
  // ... existing roles
  newrole: [
    { href: "/dashboard", icon: <LayoutDashboard />, label: "Dashboard", tooltip: "Dashboard" },
    { href: "/dashboard/settings", icon: <Settings />, label: "Settings", tooltip: "Settings" },
  ],
};
```

### Step 4: Add to login form
```typescript
// src/components/auth/login-form.tsx
<SelectItem value="newrole">New Role</SelectItem>
```

## How to Fetch Student Data

### In a Component
```typescript
import { useCurrentUser } from "@/hooks/use-current-user";

export function MyComponent() {
  const { role, email, studentData, isLoaded } = useCurrentUser();

  if (!isLoaded) return <div>Loading...</div>;

  if (role === 'student' && studentData) {
    return (
      <div>
        <p>Name: {studentData.name}</p>
        <p>Email: {studentData.email}</p>
        <p>Phone: {studentData.phone}</p>
        <p>Address: {studentData.address}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return <div>Not a student</div>;
}
```

---

## How to Protect a Route

### Option 1: Use MainLayout (Automatic)
```typescript
// src/app/dashboard/layout.tsx
// Already protected - redirects to login if not authenticated
```

### Option 2: Manual Protection
```typescript
import { useCurrentUser } from "@/hooks/use-current-user";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";

export function ProtectedComponent() {
  const { role, isLoaded } = useCurrentUser();
  const router = useRouter();

  if (!isLoaded) return <div>Loading...</div>;
  if (!role) {
    router.push("/login");
    return null;
  }

  return <div>Protected content</div>;
}
```

### Option 3: Role-Specific Protection
```typescript
export function AdminOnly() {
  const { role, isLoaded } = useCurrentUser();
  const router = useRouter();

  if (!isLoaded) return <div>Loading...</div>;
  if (role !== 'admin') {
    router.push("/dashboard");
    return null;
  }

  return <div>Admin only content</div>;
}
```

## How to Create Student Credentials

### In Admin Panel
1. Go to `/dashboard/applications`
2. Click "Approve" on a pending student application
3. Enter Student ID
4. Click "Approve Admission"
5. Credentials are automatically generated and stored

### Programmatically
```typescript
// src/components/dashboard/applications/applications-dashboard.tsx
const newCredential = {
  email: student.email,
  password: generatePassword(), // Implement this
  role: 'student'
};

const storedCredentials = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('userCredentials') || '[]');
storedCredentials.push(newCredential);
localStorage.setItem('userCredentials', JSON.stringify(storedCredentials));
```

---

## How to Display Role-Specific Content

### Using Conditional Rendering
```typescript
import { useCurrentUser } from "@/hooks/use-current-user";

export function RoleSpecificContent() {
  const { role } = useCurrentUser();

  return (
    <>
      {role === 'admin' && <AdminPanel />}
      {role === 'student' && <StudentDashboard />}
      {role === 'teacher' && <TeacherDashboard />}
      {role === 'finance' && <FinanceDashboard />}
      {role === 'hostel' && <HostelDashboard />}
    </>
  );
}
```

### Using Role-Based Navigation
```typescript

// Automatically shows different menu items based on role
```

## Common Tasks

### Task 1: Get Current User's Email
```typescript
const { email } = useCurrentUser();
console.log(email); // "student@example.com"
```

### Task 2: Get Current User's Role
```typescript
const { role } = useCurrentUser();
console.log(role); // "student" | "admin" | "teacher" | "finance" | "hostel"
```

### Task 3: Get Student's Full Profile
```typescript
const { studentData } = useCurrentUser();
if (studentData) {
  console.log(studentData.name);
  console.log(studentData.email);
  console.log(studentData.phone);
  console.log(studentData.address);
}
```

### Task 4: Logout User
```typescript
localStorage.removeItem("userRole");
localStorage.removeItem("userEmail");
localStorage.removeItem("isLoggedIn");
router.push("/login");
```

### Task 5: Check if User is Authenticated
```typescript
const isLoggedIn = localStorage.getItem("isLoggedIn") === "true";
const userRole = localStorage.getItem("userRole");
```

## Performance Tips

1. **Use useCurrentUser hook** - Caches user data
2. **Avoid re-fetching** - Data is fetched once on login
3. **Use conditional rendering** - Don't render unnecessary components
4. **Lazy load pages** - Use Next.js dynamic imports
5. **Cache avatars** - Stored in localStorage

---

## Security Reminders

⚠️ **IMPORTANT FOR PRODUCTION:**

1. Never store passwords in localStorage
2. Never hardcode passwords in code
3. Use Supabase Auth instead
4. Implement proper session management
5. Use HTTPS only
6. Add rate limiting
7. Implement 2FA for admin roles
8. Audit all access logs

---

## Troubleshooting

### Issue: User stays on login page
**Solution:** Check if `isLoggedIn` is set in localStorage

### Issue: Profile shows wrong data
**Solution:** Clear localStorage and login again

### Issue: Role-based menu not showing
**Solution:** Check if role is correctly set in localStorage

### Issue: Student data not loading
**Solution:** Check if student exists in Supabase

### Issue: Credentials not working
**Solution:** Check if credentials are in localStorage or hardcoded profiles
